name: Tally counts add to 24 and match the About totals

planSteps.description: Open the site's chart page (the base URL, hash #/) and wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Read the four tally counts: Read correctly, Misread, Blocked and Not read yet. Verify they add up to exactly 24
Verify the About panel's letters line reads 'Letters: A read correctly, B misread, C blocked, D not read yet.' where A, B, C and D are exactly the four tally counts read before

Verify the About panel's totals line reads 'The readings file holds N readings: M twin readings, K of them correct, and L lens readings.' with N equal to M plus L, and K equal to the first number in the chart's 'Twin readings correct: K of M' line
